'''Narayanaswamy Srinivasan''' (born 1962) was an Indian molecular biophysicist and a professor and the head of Proteins: Structure, Function and Evolutionary Group (N. S. Group) at the Molecular Biophysics Unit  of the [[Indian Institute of Science]].<ref name="Welcome to our labpage">{{cite web | url=http://pauling.mbu.iisc.ernet.in/index.html | title=Welcome to our labpage | publisher=Indian Institute of Science | date=2016 | access-date=23 October 2016}}</ref> He is known for his researches in the fields of computational genomics and protein structure analysis.<ref name="Brief Profile of the Awardee">{{cite web | url=http://ssbprize.gov.in/content/Detail.aspx?AID=463 | title=Brief Profile of the Awardee | publisher=Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize | date=2016 | access-date=5 October 2016}}</ref> An elected fellow of the [[Indian Academy of Sciences]]<ref name="Fellow profile - N. Srinivasan">{{cite web | url=http://www.ias.ac.in/describe/fellow/Srinivasan,_Prof._Narayanaswamy | title=Fellow profile - N. Srinivasan | publisher=Indian Academy of Sciences | date=2016 | access-date=6 October 2016}}</ref> and the [[National Academy of Sciences, India]],<ref name="NASI fellows">{{cite web | url=http://www.nasi.org.in/fellows.asp?RsFilter=S | title=NASI fellows | publisher=National Academy of Sciences, India | date=2016 | access-date=24 October 2016 | archive-date=16 March 2016 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160316043224/http://nasi.org.in/fellows.asp?RsFilter=S | url-status=dead }}</ref> he is a J. C. Bose National fellow of the [[Department of Biotechnology]] and a recipient of the [[National Bioscience Award for Career Development]] of the [[Department of Science and Technology (India)|Department of Science and Technology]].<ref name="Awardees of National Bioscience Awards for Career Development">{{cite web | url=http://dbtindia.nic.in/wp-content/uploads/2014/03/list_of_bioscience_awardees.pdf | title=Awardees of National Bioscience Awards for Career Development | publisher=Department of Biotechnology | date=2016 | access-date=17 October 2016 | archive-date=4 March 2018 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180304191331/http://dbtindia.nic.in/wp-content/uploads/2014/03/list_of_bioscience_awardees.pdf | url-status=dead }}</ref> The [[Council of Scientific and Industrial Research]], the apex agency of the Government of India for scientific research, awarded him the [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology]], one of the highest Indian science awards, in 2007, for his contributions to biological sciences.<ref name="View Bhatnagar Awardees">{{cite web | url=http://ssbprize.gov.in/Content/AwardeeList.aspx | title=View Bhatnagar Awardees | publisher=Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize | date=2016 | access-date=5 October 2016}}</ref>

== Biography ==
N. Srinivasan, born on the [[April Fool's Day]] of 1962 in [[Chennai]] in the south Indian state of [[Tamil Nadu]], graduated in physics from the [[University of Madras]] in 1982 and continued at the university to complete his master's degree in biophysics at the Department of Crystallography and Biophysics in 1984.<ref name="Biography">{{cite web | url=http://f1000.com/prime/thefaculty/member/1800911895303810?referrer=GOOGLE | title=Biography | publisher=F1000 Prime | date=2016 | access-date=23 October 2016}}</ref> Joining the [[Indian Institute of Science]] (IISc), he secured a PhD in 1991 for his thesis, ''Conformational studies on globular proteins: Data analysis'', and served as a senior research fellow at IISc, assisting [[Padmanabhan Balaram]], a noted biochemist and [[Padma Bhushan]] recipient.<ref name="Personal Details">{{cite web | url=http://oasis.csir.res.in/pidcv/osdd_pi_dcv_82.pdf | title=Personal Details | publisher=Council of Scientific and Industrial Research | date=2016 | access-date=23 October 2016}}</ref> His stint at Balaram's laboratory lasted only 10 months and in October 1991, he moved to the Department of Crystallography at [[Birkbeck College]] to work with [[Tom Blundell]] and stayed there till 1994 when he shifted his base to [[Ludwig Institute for Cancer Research]] where he had the opportunity to work under Mike Waterfield. Two years later, he was reunited with Tom Blundell at the Department of Biochemistry of the [[University of Cambridge]] and completed his post-doctoral studies there in May 1998.<ref name="Personal Details" />

Srininvasan returned to India the same year and joined the Indian Institute of Science to serve at the Molecular Biophysics Unit (MBU) as an assistant professor and a senior fellow of the [[Wellcome Trust]].<ref name="Curriculum Vitae of N. Srinivasan">{{cite web | url=http://pauling.mbu.iisc.ac.in/srini_cv_may_15.pdf | title=Curriculum Vitae of N. Srinivasan | publisher=Indian Institute of Science | date=2016 | access-date=23 October 2016}}</ref> In 2010, he was promoted as a professor and he heads the ''Proteins : Structure, Function and Evolutionary Group'', popularly known as N. S. Group, of the MBU.<ref name="Welcome to our labpage" /> In between, he served as an honorary research fellow at Birkbeck College from 1998 to 2000 and is a visiting professor at [[University of La Réunion]] (since 2004), a senior fellow at [[Manchester University]] (since 2008) and a visiting professor of [[Bioinformatics]] at [[University of Nantes]] (July 2012).<ref name="Personal Details" />

== Legacy ==
Srinivasan's researches were broadly on protein evolution with regard to its structure, functions and interactions. He worked on cellular signal transduction pathways and proteins involved in the process through modeling and computational studies.<ref name="Handbook of Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize Winners">{{cite web | url=http://www.csirhrdg.res.in/ssb.pdf | title=Handbook of Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize Winners | publisher=Council of Scientific and Industrial Research | date=1999 | access-date=5 October 2016 | pages=34 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304043957/http://www.csirhrdg.res.in/ssb.pdf | archive-date=4 March 2016 | url-status=dead }}</ref> Deploying [[computational genomics]], he is known to have assisted in identifying similar proteins with shared ''structural and functional features''. His research findings have been published in several articles;{{Refn|group=note|Please see Selected bibliography section}} online article repositories such as [[Google Scholar]]<ref name="Srinivasan on Google Scholar">{{cite web | url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=dxiu7GQAAAAJ&hl=en | title=Srinivasan on Google Scholar | publisher=Google Scholar | work=Author profile | date=2016 | access-date=24 October 2016}}</ref> and [[ResearchGate]]<ref name="Srinivasan on ResearchGate">{{cite web | url=https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Narayanaswamy_Srinivasan | title=Srinivasan on ResearchGate | work=Author profile | date=2016 | access-date=24 October 2016}}</ref> have listed 345 and 391 of his articles respectively. He has been granted patents for two of his inventions related to [[nucleotide sequences]].<ref name="Patents">{{cite web | url=https://www.google.com/search?hl=en&q=ininventor:%22Narayana+Swamy+Srinivasan%22 | title=Patents | publisher=Google patent search | date=2016 | access-date=24 October 2016}}</ref> His ongoing project, ''Multi-macromolecular assemblies'', relates to 3-D structures of large macromolecular machines.<ref name="Multi-macromolecular assemblies">{{cite web | url=https://www.researchgate.net/project/Multi-macromolecular-assemblies | title=Multi-macromolecular assemblies | work=Project log | date=2016 | access-date=24 October 2016}}</ref>

Srinivasan is a former member of the committee on ''Affiliates and Special Interests Group'' of the [[International Society for Computational Biology]] (ISCB) and a member of the Structural Biology and Structural Genomics section of the [[Faculty of 1000]].<ref name="Biography" /> He is associated with several science journals;<ref name="Curriculum Vitae of N. Srinivasan" /> as an editorial board member with [[Bioinformatics (journal)|Bioinformatics]], [[PLoS ONE]], [[Faculty of 1000#F1000Research|F1000 Research]], International Journal of Bioinformatics Research and Applications, Research and Reviews in Biosciences, [[Resonance (journal)|Resonance]], In Silico Biology, Scientific World Journal, [[Biology Direct]] and [[Scientific Reports]]; as an associate editor at ''International Journal of Knowledge Discovery in Bioinformatics'' and ''Bioinformation'' and as a guest editor with [[PLoS Computational Biology]], [[Journal of Biosciences]], ''Progress in Biophysics and Molecular Biology'' and [[Current Opinion (Elsevier)|Current Opinions in Structural Biology]].(ongoing).<ref name="Guest editor">{{cite web | url=http://www.sciencedirect.com/science/journal/0959440X/37 | title=Guest editor | publisher=Current Opinion in Structural Biology | date=2016 | access-date=24 October 2016}}</ref> He was associated with PRIB 2007, an international conference on ''Pattern Recognition In Bioinformatics'', held in Singapore in 2007 as a member of the program committee<ref name="RajapakseSchmidt2007">{{cite book|author1=Jagath C.- Rajapakse|author2=Bertil Schmidt|author3=Gwenn Volkert|title=Pattern Recognition in Bioinformatics: Second IAPR International Workshop, PRIB 2007, Singapore, October 1-2, 2007, Proceedings|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=j4IJIOLV2akC&pg=PR13|date=17 September 2007|publisher=Springer Science & Business Media|isbn=978-3-540-75285-1|pages=13–}}</ref><ref name="Final Call for Papers -- PRIB 2007">{{cite web | url=http://iubio.bio.indiana.edu:7131/bionet/mm/bionews/2007-April/006094.html | title=Final Call for Papers -- PRIB 2007 | publisher=International Association of Pattern Recognition | date=2007 | access-date=24 October 2016}}</ref> and has delivered several featured lectures and keynote addresses which included the ''Keystone Symposium on Multiprotein Complexes'' (Cambridge 2006),<ref name="Multi-Protein Complexes Involved in Cell Regulation (E6)">{{cite web | url=https://www.keystonesymposia.org/index.cfm?e=Web.Meeting.Program&MeetingID=818 | title=Multi-Protein Complexes Involved in Cell Regulation (E6) | publisher=[[Keystone Symposia]] | date=2006 | access-date=24 October 2016}}</ref> and Asia-Pacific Bioinformatics Conference (Melbourne 2012). On the academic front, he has served as the thesis examiner for a number of Indian universities{{Refn|group=note|The list includes [[Punjab University, Chandigarh, India|Punjab University, Chandigarh]], [[University of Kerala]], [[University of Hyderabad]], [[Delhi University]], [[Madurai Kamaraj University]], [[Jadavpur University]], [[Anna University]], [[University of La Réunion]], [[Shanmugha Arts, Science, Technology & Research Academy]], [[Vellore Institute of Technology]], [[Kuvempu University]], [[Macquarie University]] and [[Jawaharlal Nehru University, Delhi|Jawaharlal Nehru University]]}} and as the coordinator of integrated doctoral and BS programs in Biology of [[Indian Institute of Science]].<ref name="Personal Details" /> He also sits in the Scientific Advisory Board of ''Jubilant Biosys'', a research and development firm involved in drug discovery services.<ref name="Scientific Advisory Board">{{cite web | url=http://www.jubilantbiosys.com/about-us/scientific-advisory-board | title=Scientific Advisory Board | publisher=Jubilant Biosys | date=2016 | access-date=24 October 2016}}</ref>

== Awards and honors ==
The [[Department of Biotechnology]] of India awarded Srinivasan the [[National Bioscience Award for Career Development]] in 2004.<ref name="Awardees of National Bioscience Awards for Career Development" /> The year 2007 brought him the [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize]], one of the highest Indian science awards,<ref name="View Bhatnagar Awardees" /> as well as the elected fellowship of the [[Indian Academy of Sciences]]<ref name="Fellow profile - N. Srinivasan" /> and the [[National Academy of Sciences, India]].<ref name="NASI fellows" /> He also holds the Honorary Research Fellowship of [[Birkbeck College]] and the International Senior Fellowship of the [[Wellcome Trust]].<ref name="Prof. N.Srinivasan on Jubilant Biosys">{{cite web | url=http://www.jubilantbiosys.com/cpage.aspx?mpgid=351&pgid=355&spgid=487 | title=Prof. N.Srinivasan on Jubilant Biosys | publisher=Jubilant Biosys | date=2016 | access-date=24 October 2016}}</ref>
